assist.exactQuestion: Acquire source-addressed downside, execution-risk and falsifier evidence Alpha can reuse without setting Alpha's numeric risk or score.

claims.claim: Palantir's disclosed remaining deal value is useful demand-visibility evidence but is structurally weaker than committed revenue because contracts may include termination-for-convenience provisions and U.S. federal options cannot be exercised more than one year in advance.
causalEdges: remaining-deal-value -> potential future workload -> revenue visibility
termination rights and unexercised options -> conversion uncertainty -> realized revenue

risks.risk: Backlog/RDV confidence inflation: treating remaining deal value as guaranteed revenue would overstate demand certainty because termination rights and unexercised government options can interrupt conversion.
risks.observedWeakness: Contract structure makes some disclosed future value contingent rather than irrevocably committed.
risks.possibleImprovement: Alpha can separate contracted visibility from conversion certainty and avoid equating RDV with booked revenue.
risks.evidenceNeededToVerifyChange: Later primary filings showing realized conversion, exercised options, renewal/termination behavior, or a reconciled bridge from RDV to recognized revenue.

contradictions.statement: Large RDV supports demand visibility while contractual termination/options reduce certainty of realization; both can be true simultaneously, so this is a calibration tension rather than evidence that demand is impaired.

unknowns.unknown: The retrieved evidence does not quantify historical RDV-to-revenue conversion or termination frequency.
This assist does not establish current valuation attractiveness or Alpha's numeric risk magnitude.

gatingStatus.note: Source-addressed downside/falsifier evidence is supplied; numeric underwriting remains with council-alpha.

recommendedNextState: Use this primary-source-backed conversion-risk evidence when constructing Alpha-owned score-risk/data-confidence treatment; seek later primary conversion evidence if numeric magnitude requires it.

learning.failedStrategy: Broad Beta red-team coverage already identified concentration/model-provider risks but did not isolate a source-addressed backlog/RDV falsifier reusable by Alpha.
learning.changedStrategy: Reused a newer primary 10-Q source acquired by Scout and converted its explicit contract terms into a bounded, source-addressed conversion-risk mechanism without assigning a numeric score.
learning.nextLawfulAction: Council Alpha should decide numeric treatment; if magnitude is material, acquire later primary evidence on RDV conversion, exercised options, or terminations.
